notes.title: Demo Update & Full version Pre-Release Trailer
notes.notes:
Happy-Happy!

"As progress progresses" also the Journey to The Lost Waterpark is making progress :)



Thanks to feedback from our localization experts, our play testers and also content creators on Youtube and Twitch we were able to make even more adjustments, apply changes and did also fix bugs that must have lived inside microscopic spaces.



In short: A more polished out demo version is now available to you :) You'll find the changelog and all its previous updates in the changelog channel on our discord, linked here below.



On top of that: Please enjoy our new pre-release trailer video on the steam store page showcasing some of what is to be expected in the full version of J2LWP :)



In any way: Make sure you hop on board the steam forums, our discord or any other place where you would want to let us know about your opinion. Feedback is important and that's why we are counting on our growing community :)



Make sure to Ride and Slide & Stay Safe!
